name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 12 – Am 86
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 12a. Considers that the size of the long-term EU budget and its sources of funding must be linked to its redistributive nature, based on each Member State’s gross national income, and aligned with the objectives of economic, social and regional cohesion and the Member States’ needs, priorities and development strategies; calls, therefore, for the scrapping of rebates for certain Member States to be maintained throughout the negotiation process; opposes the introduction of new own resources;
